title: Reverse Nodes in k-Group
statement: Reverse the nodes of the list k at a time and return the modified list. If the number of nodes is not a multiple of k, the final leftover nodes stay in their original order.
reference_solution:
def reverseKGroup(head, k):
    dummy = ListNode(0, head)
    prev = dummy
    while True:
        node = prev
        cnt = 0
        while cnt < k and node.next:
            node = node.next
            cnt += 1
        if cnt < k:
            break
        group_start = prev.next
        cur, p = group_start, node.next
        for _ in range(k):
            tmp = cur.next
            cur.next = p
            p = cur
            cur = tmp
        prev.next = p
        prev = group_start
    return dummy.next

hints.1_question: First check that there are really k nodes left. If not, stop and leave the rest alone.
hints.2_nudge: For each full group: reverse k nodes in place (like reversing a list), then connect the previous group's tail to the new head and this group's old head to what follows.
hints.3_big_hint: Find the k-th node from prev. If fewer than k remain, break. Reverse k nodes with cur/p; prev.next = p; prev = group_start.
